async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Set the date range for the orders report: from May 1, 2021 to March 31, 2022
    from_date = "05/01/2021"
    to_date = "03/31/2022"
    
    # Fill the 'From' date field
    from_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="From *")
    await from_field.fill(from_date)
    
    # Fill the 'To' date field
    to_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="To *")
    await to_field.fill(to_date)

    show_report_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Show Report")
    await show_report_button.click()

    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
